//: The field at each end of a flight, as the build (_field_offset_ft in flown/terrain.py, over a flat model) and the page (fieldFt in flown/frontend/calculations/groundProfile.ts) both read it from the taxiing. Rows are [altitude ft, groundspeed kt, timed]; start and end are the field in feet, null for none. tests/test_terrain.py and tests/frontend/unit/calculations/fieldGround.test.ts run every case.

cases.name: taxiing at both ends, the upper median of each
too short a taxi at the start
a speed of 0 is none and ends the taxiing
a row without a time ends the taxiing
a line without times has no field
in the air at both ends
